message.reasoning_content: These are Let It Be tracks—produced by Phil Spector, though George Martin produced Let It Be... Naked? Actually George Martin produced those tracks (Glyn Johns), sessions produced by George Martin; Spector did post-production. Martin is credited as producer on Let It Be album? The album credits Phil Spector. But the original sessions were produced by George Martin. Hmm. "One After 909" — Spector did not overdub it; it's basically Glyn Johns mix. The Beatles Bible credits producer George Martin for these tracks? Let It Be tracks list producer: George Martin. Yes, Beatles Bible credits Martin. So answer: all four? Pick one... "Dig It" maybe. Actually all produced by Martin at Apple. Choose One After 909? Any of them correct; pick one, say "Dig It" probability moderate.
